name: JIHO KIM
headline: C++ SYSTEMS / AI BACKENDS / UNITY INTERACTION / HAPTICS & XR

sections.title: PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
paragraphs: Systems-focused developer working across C++ middleware, AI backends, Unity interactions, and haptics/XR research. Built and operated the complete AI backend for a VR historical NPC on Amazon EC2 g5.xlarge, including client communication and logging. Implemented Unity game logic, interactions, objects, and animations for a LiDAR SDK-driven multi-projection CAVE escape room. Since June 2022, independently developing cross-platform C++20 audio middleware and native Godot integrations. Currently researching sensor-to-rendering MR haptic workflows at Kyung Hee University.

items.title: Greatman - VR Historical NPC
items.subtitle: AI Backend Developer / AWS Deployment
bullets: Owned the full server and AI backend configuration, connecting speech recognition, retrieval, LLM response generation, and speech synthesis.
Deployed and operated the backend on Amazon EC2 g5.xlarge; implemented VR client communication and dialogue logging; assisted with user experiments.
Collaborated with a separate Unity VR client developer. Project-level field use: 42 participants and 126 sessions; related coauthor paper published in Applied Sciences (2026).

items.title: CAVE Escape Room
items.subtitle: Unity Interaction / Game Logic / Objects / Animation
bullets: Implemented interactions, game logic, game objects, and animations for an escape-room experience in a multi-projection CAVE space.
Used a LiDAR SDK for data processing and integrated wall-touch input into Unity content and game behavior.

items.title: M.S. Researcher - Haptics / XR
items.subtitle: Haptics Lab, Kyung Hee University | Mar 2025 - Present
bullets: Developing an end-to-end Meta Quest 3 workflow for haptic texture acquisition, modeling, and vibrotactile rendering.
Implemented 1 kHz acceleration/force sensing, AR/LSF models and interpolation, native C/C++ Godot integration, and OpenXR floating-point haptic PCM.

items.title: Project DJ Engine - Solo Open-Source Developer
items.subtitle: Cross-Platform C++20 Audio Middleware | Jun 2022 - Present
bullets: Designed playback, editing, DSP, device input, rhythm-game judgment, IPC and persistence across core, Godot wrapper and prebuilt distribution repositories.
Maintained CMake/Conan builds and CI/CD delivery for Windows, Linux and macOS, including prebuilt Godot GDExtension packages.

items.title: Undergraduate Researcher - CVLab
items.subtitle: Hoseo University | Mar 2023 - Dec 2024
bullets: Implemented C++/OpenCV landmark-based face alignment and inference preprocessing; worked with TensorRT enqueueV3, pinned host memory and CUDA stream synchronization.

bullets: Implemented portable FFT/STFT kernels using OCCA/OKL with CUDA and OpenCL execution paths, asynchronous transport and runtime fallback; profiled on NVIDIA H100.
